label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User-controlled host parameter flows through resolveHost() for DNS resolution, then the SAME hostname string is used in fetchHttpByHostname() for outbound HTTP request. The DNS resolution and fetch are separated - between resolveHost() returning and fetchHttpByHostname() executing, DNS records could change (DNS rebinding window). Even though isNonPublicAddress() guards against known internal IPs, the actual fetch uses the hostname which could resolve differently at fetch time. Resolved sink value: http://<hostname>/api where hostname comes directly from user input.

evidence.note: User param -> host var -> resolveHost(host) -> isNonPublicAddress check -> fetchHttpByHostname(host)
fetchHttpByHostname constructs URL from host parameter for outbound fetch
